avoid_supplements.name: Immunosuppressive supplements (e.g., high-dose astragalus, reishi mushroom)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immunosuppressive effects or interfere with erenumab's mechanism of action
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult healthcare provider before initiating immunomodulatory supplements

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance vasodilatory effects; magnesium has mild CGRP pathway involvement
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased headache relief or adverse effects; use standard recommended doses

caution_supplements.name: Riboflavin (Vitamin B2)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive migraine prophylaxis benefits
caution_supplements.action: Concurrent use is generally safe; monitor for enhanced therapeutic effect

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Tyramine may trigger migraines independent of erenumab; not a direct interaction but clinical relevance in migraine management
caution_foods.action: Maintain dietary awareness as part of comprehensive migraine management strategy

monitoring_notes: Erenumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal hepatic metabolism and no significant drug-metabolizing enzyme interactions. Monitor for injection site reactions, cardiovascular changes, and migraine pattern changes during therapy.
